challenges: ヒイロ・ユイ (pilot, glossary 'Heero Yui', official via akurasu Z3.2): the official English is 'Heero Yuy' (https://gundam.fandom.com/wiki/Heero_Yuy, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Mobile_Suit_Gundam_Wing_characters); akurasu's own Heero_Yuy character page and its Endless Waltz page also write Yuy. Not flagged in the brief and the Z3.2 pilot database wins by precedence, so this is low priority; I used 'Heero Yuy' for the assassinated colony leader (ヒイロ・ユイ#keyword). If the pilot stays 'Yui', the two spellings will differ for the same alias.

ゼクス・マーキス (glossary 'Zechs Marquise'): Gundam Wiki, Wikipedia and Bandai write 'Zechs Merquise' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Mobile_Suit_Gundam_Wing_characters). Akurasu Z3.2 uses Marquise (and 'Zechs Marquise' is a familiar variant), so probably leave; noted only for completeness.
ヒルデ・シュバイカー (glossary 'Hilde Schubaker'): Gundam Wiki/Wikipedia write 'Hilde Schbeiker'. Akurasu Z3.2 wins; noted only for completeness.
uncertain: カムラン: chose the English-release spelling 'Cameron Bloom' (Gundam Wiki https://gundam.fandom.com/wiki/Cameron_Bloom, Wikipedia CCA cast table, ja Wikipedia's official-romanization heading). The briefs' 'Camran Bloom' (pt_062, unverified) and 'Kamran Bruhm' (rt_000, no source found) are not supported. Pilot 91 CHFN/CHNN were pending in the glossary and can be set to 'Cameron Bloom' / 'Cameron'.

グリプス戦役: 'Gryps War' (Jigoku shipped, alias on Gundam Wiki) vs 'Gryps Conflict' (Gundam Wiki title, Wikipedia). The brief's claim that the akurasu srw glossary says 'Gryps Conflict' is not in the saved glossary page. Kept Gryps War to match 'First/Second Neo Zeon War' (gundam_4).
ルナツー: 'Luna II' (Gundam Wiki, CCA plot) chosen over 'Luna Two' (dub/rt_000) and Jigoku's 'Ruuna Two'. Both official forms exist; pick one corpus-wide.
ジオン・ダイクン (keyword, proposed): 'Zeon Deikun' mirrors the Japanese token (no Zum). Alternative: 'Zeon Zum Deikun' for both this and ジオン・ズム・ダイクン.

Lowercase terms: colony laser, psycommu, psycoframe, funnel follow the English sources (lowercase in prose) and NAME_RESEARCH style; Jigoku wrote them capitalized ('Colony Laser', 'Psycoframe', 'Funnel'). gundam_1 also writes 'colony drop', 'Newtype'. サイコミュ is already written サイコミュ|lc in prose. If a token starts a sentence the builder must capitalize it.
ゼロシステム = 'ZERO System' (official capitalization) rather than Jigoku's 'Zero System'.
チェーミン = 'Cheimin' (Gundam Wiki page, Wikipedia CCA cast). ja Wikipedia's Zeta list writes 'Cheemin'; Jigoku's 'Chammy' has no source.

地球圏統一連合 = 'United Earth Sphere Alliance' (official UESA), not the brief's 'Earth Sphere Unified Alliance'. Pilot 99's DSCR also uses 地球圏統一国家 (post-war state), which is in no brief and not in the glossary: official 'Earth Sphere Unified Nation' (https://gundam.fandom.com/wiki/Earth_Sphere_Unified_Nation). Someone needs to own it.

キャスリン: Catherine Bloom is the Gundam Wing character; the akurasu Z3 pilot list has an unrelated 'Catherine Glass' (Macross Quarter bridge crew, Macross series) so the glossary must keep them distinct if both tokens exist.
ケネディ = 'Kennedy' (Wikipedia Zeta list: 'Kennedy Space Museum'; Kennedy Space Center). Place-name reading, no Japanese-side source beyond the DSCR itself.
ヘビーアームズ改: the akurasu Z3.2 mech list spells the Japanese ガンダムヘビーアーム改 (missing ズ), an evident typo; the English 'Gundam Heavyarms Custom' is unaffected.

Genders taken from wiki, not from the DSCR text, for pilots 96 Wufei, 102 Hilde, 85 Gyunei, 86 Rezin (ja Wikipedia: 男勝りの女性), 89 Chan, 73 Fa, 74 Four, 79 Haman: translators should not rely on the Japanese line alone for these; Rezin is a woman despite the gender-blank DSCR.

ドーリアン (token): stands for Relena's adoptive father, Vice Foreign Minister Darlian; Relena's adoptive mother is Mareen Darlian, so the surname alone is ambiguous outside the 'Vice Foreign Minister' phrase.

Trowa (pilot 94): 'Trowa Barton' is a borrowed name; his real identity is unresolved in the canon (Gundam Wiki calls him a 'nameless young engineer'; the wiki-speculated 'Triton Bloom' is unconfirmed). Not used in nicknames.

Sources: gundam.fandom.com pages were read through the wiki's MediaWiki API (direct page fetches are blocked); the cited URLs are the corresponding article pages. No Tengoku-specific akurasu page lists these Gundam Wing/Zeta/CCA support names, so most are official-English (tier 5) or Jigoku-library (tier 4) decisions; akurasu (tier 2/3) settled Sanc Kingdom, Heavyarms Custom, Sandrock, Libra, Radish, Argama, Henken Bekkener, Kayra Su.
